about: INFINOS – A modern tribute to arcade shoot’em ups Get ready for an explosive experience with Infinos, a horizontal pixel art shoot’em up blending retro style with fast-paced gameplay. Inspired by the greatest arcade classics, Infinos is for nostalgic players and thrill-seekers alike. In a distant future, the planet Infinos faces a devastating alien invasion. The last hope: the Fauria, a prototype fighter jet piloted by one hero. Fight through six intense levels filled with enemies, traps, and epic bosses, all in richly detailed environments. Key features:
Dynamic retro-inspired soundtrack Defend humanity. Every pixel counts.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
